title: Nature sentences
intro: Ten sentences about growing, flowing things. There is no clock to beat.
lines: Moss grows slowly on the shady side of old stone walls.
A river bends where the ground is softest.
Leaves turn their faces toward the light all day long.
After the rain, the grass smells green and fresh.
Roots spread out under the soil, holding the tree in place.
Waves roll in, break on the sand and slip back out again.
Bees visit flower after flower, one small trip at a time.
Clouds form when warm, damp air rises and cools.
A single acorn can grow into a very tall oak tree.
Frost draws fine patterns on the window on a cold morning.
